description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Alena.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Alena.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Alena from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Alena.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Alena.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Repeat.
